title: model-development
summary: The model line derives, discretizes and implements a model of ice, water vapor and heat in a regolith pore space, then writes a teaching document. The script run_md.py owns the loop and the state (runs.db and files); every agent call gets a fresh context and one work order, and all four agents run claude-opus-5-5.

Each stage's output is checked by something other than its producer: the verifier writes the checks for M1, M3 and M4 and the tests in M5, library_search.py checks every quoted citation, and mutate.py plants bugs to measure the tests. A Stop hook runs each stage's structural pre-check and every call must return schema output, or it is retried once.

Solver runs go only through run_test.sh with caps: at most 8 ranks, 20k to 100k DOFs per rank, a 30 minute timeout, and the locked test list only; in M6 a failing test gets at most 3 fix rounds before the foreman triages it. The user decides at six blocking gates (scope, selection, derivation, discretization, test lock, write-up); the doc 18 comparison and the M8 settings are non-blocking review items; a mutation miss reopens the test lock.
status: design approved with changes (2026-11-16); S3:Build next

Station scripts: work order from a fixed template, call agent, audit transcript, run checks, retry once on a malformed result
Refuses to start if a frozen hash differs

runs.db: one row per agent call and check
derivation/, checks/, triage/, gates/, transcripts/

details: Timeout: agentlib default 1200 s

nodes.title: M1 beth-modeler

Does not read docs/planning/ (independence from doc 18)
Writes only <run>/derivation/**

nodes.title: derivation/spec_problem.md
nodes.job: The contract every later stage reads.

library_search.py quote: text on the cited page
Stop hook: structural pre-check

nodes.title: checks/m1_*.py and results
nodes.job: The verifier's check scripts and their verdicts.

nodes.title: G:Scope (blocking)

details: Shown: spec_problem.md, check results, every citation
Skipped: derivation drifts or uses laws that fail in vacuum

nodes.title: M2: Selection
nodes.job: Station script: calls the modeler to score at least four model types and runs the quote check.
details: Candidates: body-fitted two-phase, diffuse domain or smoothed boundary, three-phase phase field, sharp interface or level set

nodes.title: M2 beth-modeler
nodes.job: Scores at least four candidate model types against the M1 requirements, with sourced scores.
details: Criteria: fidelity, geometry flexibility, DOF cost, fit to PetIGA, buildable by December

nodes.title: derivation/selection.md
nodes.job: The sourced scores, and the citation list.
details: Also derivation/citations.json

nodes.title: M2 quote check
nodes.job: Checks every citation with library_search.py quote.
details: Passes when the quote is on the cited page (whitespace and case normalized only)

nodes.title: G:Selection (blocking)
nodes.job: Picks the model type and names the model (the <model> in feat/<model>).
details: Skipped: the line derives a model the user did not choose

nodes.title: M3: Derivation
nodes.job: Station script: calls the modeler for the derivation; timeout 3600 s.

nodes.title: M3 beth-modeler
nodes.job: Derives the strong form, scales, floors, wall condition and sharp-interface limit; every ledger step is cited, derived, an assumption or a choice.
details: Reduction to Residual_A1 is checked, not assumed
Thin-interface correction: applies or not

nodes.title: derivation/ledger.json, derivation.md
nodes.job: The step ledger and the derivation text.

nodes.title: M3 checks
nodes.job: Runs the verifier's SymPy checks and compare_doc18.py (term by term diff against doc 18, evaluation only).
details: checks/m3_*.py: reduction to Residual_A1, conservation, energy, units, each named operation, unlisted assumptions
Schema check: no step without a source
Planted ledger errors (sign, factor, exponent) must each fail a check first

nodes.title: M3 beth-verifier
nodes.job: Writes SymPy checks from the ledger's claims, not from the modeler's reasoning.
details: Does not read docs/planning/ (doc 18 hidden)

nodes.title: checks/m3_*.py and results
nodes.job: Check scripts, verdicts and the doc 18 diff.

nodes.title: Review: doc 18 comparison (not blocking)
nodes.job: Reads the diff of the agent's strong form against doc 18, the F2 pore-space derivation; the line goes on.
details: Evaluation, not a gate

nodes.title: G:Derivation (blocking)
nodes.job: Answers each choice (C#) and confirms the cited claims.
details: Shown: derivation.md, check results, C# list, doc 18 diff
Skipped: an unchecked equation becomes the spec

nodes.title: M4: Discretization
nodes.job: Station script: calls the modeler to write the frozen spec; timeout 3600 s.

nodes.title: M4 beth-modeler
nodes.job: Writes spec.md (weak form, IGA and generalized-alpha, residual and Jacobian, dt rule) and code_map.json.
details: First checks in PETSc 3.20 whether TSAdapt's error estimate works with TSALPHA or the //AM patch stays
Manufactured-solution sources

nodes.title: derivation/spec.md, code_map.json, mms/
nodes.job: The specification and the map from each term to assembly.c and its runtime option.

nodes.title: M4 checks
nodes.job: Runs the verifier's checks: weak and strong form agree, symbolic Jacobian equals the differentiated residual, groups are consistent.
details: checks/m4_*.py

nodes.title: M4 beth-verifier
nodes.job: Writes the weak versus strong, Jacobian and dimensionless group checks from the spec.

nodes.title: checks/m4_*.py and results
nodes.job: Check scripts and verdicts.

nodes.title: G:Discretization (blocking)
nodes.job: Freezes the spec; its hash goes into the manifest.
details: Skipped: code and tests could target different equations

nodes.title: M5: Test lock
nodes.job: Station script: calls the verifier to write the tests from the spec, before any code exists.

nodes.title: M5 beth-verifier
nodes.job: Writes the test list and scripts from spec.md and code_map.json, never seeing the feature code.
details: Reads src/ on main only, for regressions
Tests: regression, full Jacobian, manufactured solutions, closed-box water, energy, front speed, 90 degree contact, separate refinement, xi sensitivity, neck width, cost budget

nodes.title: studies/<model>/tests/, tests.json
nodes.job: Locked test list and scripts on feat/<model>, with a cost budget per test.

nodes.title: M5 run_test.sh
nodes.job: Runs every test; regressions must pass on main and each test must fit the run caps.
details: Caps: lock file, at most 8 ranks, 20k to 100k DOFs per rank, 30 min timeout, locked list only

nodes.title: G:Test lock (blocking)
nodes.job: Sets the tolerances; the tests are hashed and locked by a hook.
details: Shown: test list with proposed tolerances and reasons
Skipped: the coder could pass tests the user would not accept

nodes.title: M6: Implementation (loop)
nodes.job: Station script: gives the modeler one layer at a time (heat, vapor, phase field, coupling, wall term).
details: Timeout 3600 s
Each layer must pass before the next

nodes.title: M6 beth-modeler
nodes.job: Writes the C code behind a runtime option, default off, and fixes one failing test at a time (at most 3 rounds).
details: Writes src/ and include/ in the feature worktree only
Cannot edit tests, checks or tolerances
May dispute a test, with evidence only

nodes.title: feat/<model> branch: C code
nodes.job: Code behind a runtime option, default off.
details: Commits recorded in the manifest at each gate

nodes.title: M6 run_test.sh
nodes.job: After each layer: build, full Jacobian test, the layer's tests, then all earlier tests; logs wall time, Newton and Krylov iterations and dt.
details: Same caps as M5
Locked list green and last layer committed: go to M7

nodes.title: test logs, runs.db
nodes.job: Logs and one row per call and check.

nodes.title: M6 beth-model-foreman (triage)
nodes.job: After 3 failed fix rounds, reads the evidence and returns one route with its reason, in one call.
details: Routes: code, spec, test, tolerance or environment
Rules on a modeler's dispute; an unresolved dispute goes to the user
Also writes the gate summaries (gates/<gate>.md)
Cannot run anything or edit code, tests or specs
Routes are compared at the end with a fixed rule table

nodes.title: triage/<n>.json
nodes.job: One routing decision with its reason.

nodes.title: User: tolerance or environment
nodes.job: Decides a tolerance or environment problem, or an unresolved test dispute.

nodes.title: M6 beth-verifier (test bug)
nodes.job: Fixes a test the foreman ruled wrong, or answers a dispute in one call.
details: Writes studies/<model>/tests/ and tests.json; the user re-locks
Does not read the feature branch's src/

nodes.title: M7: Mutation
nodes.job: Applies about 10 planted bugs, each in a scratch worktree, and records which test caught each.
details: Examples: wall term sign, missing weight, dropped Jacobian term, wrong floor, eps_s below mesh resolution

nodes.title: M7 beth-verifier (on a miss)
nodes.job: Adds a new test for each planted bug that no test caught.
details: Missed bug: new test waits for the user to re-lock

nodes.title: mutation.json
nodes.job: Which test caught each planted bug.

nodes.title: Re-lock after a mutation miss (blocking)
nodes.job: Approves the new test for each missed bug and re-locks the list (G:Test lock reopened); M8 waits.

nodes.title: M8: Performance
nodes.job: Station script: measures solver settings on two fixed cases with perf.py; all tests stay green after every change.
details: BiCGStab or GMRES; ASM with ILU(k), block Jacobi, field split; MUMPS in 2D if available
dt rule against a small-dt reference
Strong scaling at 20k, 50k, 100k DOFs per rank

nodes.title: M8 beth-modeler
nodes.job: Changes solver settings and commits the chosen ones as the model's defaults on the branch.
details: Writes src/ and include/ in the feature worktree only

nodes.title: perf.csv, settings
nodes.job: Measured settings, committed as the branch's defaults.

nodes.title: Review: M8 settings (not blocking)
nodes.job: Reads the measured settings and the local target for alloc.sh; the line goes on.

nodes.title: M9: Write-up
nodes.job: Station script: calls the writer with the ledger, spec, results and perf.csv.

nodes.title: M9 beth-writer
nodes.job: Writes the linear teaching document in a fixed 13-part order, from the files and not from memory.
details: Reused from .claude/agents/
Each part uses only what came before

nodes.title: docs/model/<model>.md
nodes.job: The teaching document: problem to limitations.

nodes.title: M9 checks
nodes.job: Runs check_doc.py and the citation check, then a fresh-context student review of the document alone.
details: check_doc.py: every symbol defined before first use, every number traced to a file
Student redoes the reduction at psi = 1 and one Jacobian entry, and lists steps it could not follow

nodes.title: G:Write-up (blocking)
nodes.job: Reads the document and the student's list, then accepts or sends it back.
details: Skipped: the user does not learn the model
